normalization_plan.reason: addrs is a per-call routing parameter whose only security effect is choosing branches and destinations inside buyNftForERC20
swapDetails exists solely to supply the raw payload for the delegatecall operation in buyNftForERC20
buyDetails is the per-call struct consumed entirely by the _buyNFT delegatecall loop
newFees is a transient parameter that is immediately written to the FEES state variable inside updateFees
_recipient is only used as the destination in _returnChange's swap payloads and token transfers
proxy is a short-lived local that holds the delegatecall target consumed by _swap
success is a temporary local capturing the delegatecall result that _swap immediately checks
inputERC20s is the per-call struct carrying caller token data exclusively into _transferHelper
